title: Lootbox Retired Seed Pair
description: A retired commit-reveal seed pair. The server_seed is now revealed so players can verify past rolls. Persisted in lootbox_retired table. Multiple rows per player_id (one per rotation).

server_seed.description: Revealed server seed. Players can verify SHA256(server_seed) === server_seed_hash.

server_seed_hash.description: The hash that was published before the seed was revealed.

client_seed.description: Client seed that was in effect during this round.

nonce.description: Final nonce value when the pair was retired.

created_at.description: ISO 8601. When this seed pair was created.

retired_at.description: ISO 8601. When this seed pair was rotated out.
